items.hook: The Warsaw radio mast, then the tallest construction ever built, collapses.
items.body: The Warsaw radio mast was a radio mast located near Gąbin, Poland, and was the world's tallest structure at 646.30 m (2,120 ft) from 1974 until its collapse on 8 August 1991. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Line 2 of the Nanjing Metro is a subway line that runs mainly in an east-west direction on the Nanjing Metro network, running from Jingtianlu to Youfangqiao; it entered operation on May 28, 2010.
items.body: It covers a length of 37.95 km (23.58 mi) with 26 stations. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919 is signed. It establishes peaceful relations between Afghanistan and the UK, and confirms the Durand line as the mutual border. In return, the UK is no longer obligated to subsidize the Afghan government.
items.body: The Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919, also known as the Treaty of Rawalpindi, was a bilateral treaty which brought the Third Anglo-Afghan War to an end.This is regarded as the largest peace treaty since the Treaty of Versailles, which was enacted in the same year. The world is stranger than it lets on.
